target_customer: At launch, AI developers paying testers; later, local restaurants buying guest acquisition
problem: AI developers needed human testers to find model weaknesses; the restaurant product addresses getting new guests to return as regulars.
business_model: Marketplace and services; Upswell restaurant growth packages listed at roughly $700 to $30,000+ per year
product_category: AI model testing marketplace, later restaurant growth platform (Upswell)

founders.name: Jeong-Suh Choi
previous_startups: Sold his last startup before joining eBay (per YC page, name not given)
founders.background_notes: Product manager at eBay and Facebook; from Seoul.

technical_complexity.rationale: Testing platform with model auto-expiry and payouts is standard marketplace engineering; the restaurant quiz product is simpler.

defensibility.rationale: Marketplaces for crowd testing and restaurant promotion were easy to replicate, and the product changed twice.

market_need_then: The July 2022 TechCrunch launch said developers wanted faster validation of AI models and could earn $10 to $20 per hour testing; no spend data found.

branding.domain_note: Company site is upswell.ai; product brand Upswell is separate from the company name Bobidi

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident, plain-spoken; headlines such as 'Engineered lines, not lucky ones'

branding.brand_signature: Tagline 'Make every day a Grand Opening' for Upswell

rebrands.to: Upswell (restaurant growth product by Bobidi, Inc.)
rebrands.why: Not stated; Upswell is described as a product of Bobidi, Inc.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; the product brand Upswell replaced the company name in public positioning.

pivots.from: Crowd testing marketplace for AI models (TechCrunch, July 2022)
pivots.to: Upswell restaurant growth and quiz rewards (YC page and upswell.ai)

outcome_analysis: Bobidi raised a reported $5.8M seed in July 2022 for an AI model testing marketplace, then appears to have moved to Upswell, a restaurant guest acquisition product. It is listed as active with about seven people and no exit or shutdown news. The cause and timing of the change are not public, so its outcome is unresolved.
notes: Seed of $5.8M in July 2022 is reported by FinSMEs (could not open, 403), startupintros and thesaasnews, all funding news outlets; the investor list is from a search summary. CB Insights lists a pre-seed on 2021-09-28 with no amount. Total funding varies by database ($5.7M to $8.3M), unverified. The YC page links the TechCrunch launch article of 2022-07-14 and no competitors; no dated competitor evidence found, so the list is empty.
